drills.procedure: Replace the candidate image with one previous immutable image across each service and init container while preserving the single owner, retained claim, and configured RocksDB path; compensate a failed provisioning workflow before retry.
Atomically reactivate a previously validated immutable policy version and advance the authorization epoch so caches cannot retain the superseded decision state.
Atomically point the function at a prior healthy immutable version; failed and subsequently unhealthy versions remain ineligible for promotion.
Keep the last compatible schema active when an incompatible publication requires a migration; do not destructively downgrade stored documents.
Recover by rotating forward to a fresh signing key while retaining prior public keys for the token-overlap window; never reactivate retired or suspected-compromised private material.
Stop writes, verify format compatibility, and open the same fenced non-empty local RocksDB volume with the previous binary; never fall back to memory or an empty path.
